pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What the PlainlyKit Temporary Email MCP server is, its stdio MCP topology, and links to child pages.

page_notes.content: The README introduction identifies two useful official resources for developers. In the overview explain that this server adapts the existing receive-only service, with Markdown links to [PlainlyKit Temporary Email](https://plainlykit.com/tools/temporary-email) and the [official API documentation](https://plainlykit.com/developers/temporary-email). These are the service and API that this repository actually implements, not installation targets or hosted MCP endpoints. Preserve the real limitations and avoid promotional claims.
